Patient opening round-up for the welfare crew
The desk kept a steady pace

The month stayed calm overall, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways kept service consistent from first check-in to final handoff. Most cases moved through smoothly, with careful scheduling, clear guidance, and a steady focus on animal comfort. We kept the tone reassuring for travelers and the work practical for the team.

The safety coordinator stayed active on hazards and prevention, with close attention to crate fit, gate handling, and calm transfer routes. Staff continued to check each animal with patience and use plain language with travelers, which helped reduce stress at busy moments. <<FACT F034>> Communication remained concise, kind, and actionable, especially when travel plans changed or a pet needed a little extra support.

Operationally, the desk handled the usual mix of pre-trip questions, document checks, and boarding support without major disruption. The team did a good job keeping movement organized, and handoffs between the counters and the ramp stayed steady. When cases needed more care, the staff took the time to settle the animal first and then move forward, which helped keep the whole process smooth. Trixie came through her trip with good support, and that reflected the kind of patient handling we want to keep standard.

Coordination with the wider airport teams also held up well. We had a clear rhythm for updates, and that made it easier to keep travelers informed without adding noise. The desk stayed focused on comfort, safety, and simple next steps, which is still the right formula for this kind of operation.

Looking ahead, we will keep reinforcing calm handling, early checks, and quick communication. The next month should be manageable if we stay consistent and continue giving each animal the same careful attention we showed this month.
